local_review.finding_body: In tests/src/org.xerial.snappy/snappy-java/1.0.5.3/src/test/java/org_xerial_snappy/snappy_java/SnappyLoaderTest.java, hasUnsupportedSnappyNativeLoaderFailure accepted any native-runtime org.xerial.snappy.SnappyError whose stack mentioned SnappyLoader.injectSnappyNativeLoader. This tolerates a recognized Native Image failure without verifying it through NativeImageSupport.isUnsupportedFeatureError, violating the enumerated Native Image dodging rule. The smallest compliant correction exposes that nativeTest is not green because snappy-java discards the underlying UnsupportedFeatureError cause.
local_review.finding_title: Native-only SnappyError is swallowed without UnsupportedFeatureError verification
local_review.fix_note: Narrowed the catch to Error, removed the native-runtime class-name/stack-trace fallback, and retained tolerance only when an Error in the cause chain passes NativeImageSupport.isUnsupportedFeatureError. This preserves the useful partial correction, but nativeTest now fails and requires a compliant test design or upstream-compatible solution before approval.
local_review.review_comment: The diff is scoped to org.xerial.snappy:snappy-java:1.0.5.3, uses only reachability-metadata.json, and keeps one latest index entry. The reported repair coverage gates pass: overall 13/13 to 12/13 (7.69 percentage-point drop), reflection 8/8 to 8/8, and resources 5/5 to 4/5 (one-call small-report drop). Index validation in the supplied evidence passed; after the correction, local checkstyle, checkMetadataFiles, and javaTest pass. The full test lane still fails in nativeTest because SnappyError hides an UnsupportedFeatureError while loading SnappyNativeLoader, so the repaired tree cannot be approved.
